name: Current tag
desc: The tag as it is today: the letters pulse and drift a little.

name: Calm
desc: Text stays perfectly still; only the hearts and colour blobs pulse (original, minus the text shift).

name: Sonar ripple
desc: Two white rings expand outward from the badge and fade, like a sonar ping. Text is still.

name: Shimmer
desc: A bright highlight sweeps across the letters, then rests.

name: Letter wave
desc: Letters hop up one after another in a quick wave, then pause.

name: Neon flicker
desc: The whole word flickers like a neon sign every few seconds.

name: Glow breathing
desc: The glow around the letters slowly swells and shrinks; letters themselves never move.

name: Gloss streak
desc: A glossy diagonal streak glides across the whole badge, like polished glass.

name: Border chase
desc: A bright dash of light runs around the badge border, forever circling.

name: Star twinkle
desc: Four-point stars blink on and off across the badge at staggered times.

name: Pop
desc: Each letter pops bigger for a moment in sequence, like a bouncing lyric.

name: Marquee flash
desc: Each letter lights up white for an instant in turn, like theatre marquee bulbs.

name: Spotlight
desc: A soft round spotlight drifts back and forth over the letters, lighting them white as it passes.

name: Pixel Dawn
desc: A pixel-art sunrise skyline banner with a chunky PIXELCONS wordmark and twinkling sparkles. One embedded PNG, so it stays light and sharp.

name: Pixel Night
desc: The skyline after dark: crescent moon, shooting star, glowing wordmark and lit windows.

name: Pixel Arcade
desc: Retro synthwave: striped sun, neon grid floor, scanlines and a pink-glow wordmark.

name: Pixel Space
desc: A starfield with nebula clouds, a ringed gold planet and a blue moon behind the wordmark.

name: Pixel City Pop
desc: Retro Japan, 80s city pop: a white Countach cruises an elevated road above a pastel Tokyo skyline with street lights and a bus stop, toward a sign with a heart-shaped sobbing face and an arrow. Katakana (ピクセルコンズ) runs down the side.

name: Pixel City Pop: Gold to Blue
desc: City Pop again, but the whole scene follows the guild gradient: golden hour on the left cooling to blue on the right, down to the skyline, road tint and lamp glow.

name: Pixel Sky
desc: Bright sky islands with trees, a little red-roofed house and drifting clouds.
